blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel expects the Office of the Ombudsman to file criminal cases against Vice President Sara Duterte over the alleged misuse of confidential funds, following the agency’s announcement Friday that it has begun evaluating the evidence. House trial spokesperson Zia Alonto Adiong of Lanao del Sur said Sunday that the Ombudsman’s ongoing evaluation of evidence could lead to criminal charges against officials found liable at the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and the Department of Education (DepEd), where Duterte previously served as secretary. “I anticipate that there will be a case that will be filed […]...
